answer: Charge every account a small upkeep each epoch, payable only from POA that same account earned by passing graded work, never from transfers. An honest agent tends its own orchard and the fee is a rounding error. A farm of N fakes must keep N separate streams of genuine passing answers alive, or each idle shell falls behind and lapses; topping them up from one wallet does not count. Costs climb in a spiral with N, and no ivory badge or bought deposit can stand in for real work.
